sources.description: Directories to load plugins from, in priority order. When duplicate plugin names exist, the first source wins. Project sources come before user sources; a project entry with the same resolved path as a user entry replaces it. If no config file declares `sources`, the default is one `claude` source at ~/.agents/plugins.

path.description: Directory. `~` is expanded; relative paths are resolved from the directory of the config file.

format.description: `claude`: a Claude plugin tree (installed_plugins.json, known_marketplaces.json, cache/, marketplaces/). `agent-plugins`: a directory whose immediate children are Agent Plugins packages (root plugin.json). `auto`: look at each plugin's manifests.

label.description: Suffix of Agent Plugins ids (<name>@<label>). Defaults to the directory name (or its parent's name for a directory called `plugins`).

enabled.description: Set to false to switch a source off, for example in a project to turn off a user source.

enabledPlugins.description: Plugin id -> true/false. Plugins are enabled unless set to false. Project keys override user keys; both override the legacy plugins.json files.
